authority: Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities planning.data.gov.uk

claims.statement: The official Planning Data API exposes more than 100 England planning and housing datasets through one consistent interface.
Latitude and longitude queries return entities whose geometries intersect the constructed point.
Multiple dataset parameters may be supplied and results may come from any requested dataset.
The q parameter supports postcode or UPRN searching and UPRN is described as more precise than a coordinate for registered properties.
geometry_entity filters against geometry belonging to identified entities rather than requiring pasted raw polygons.
geometry_reference and geometry_curie support geometry-based filtering through references or CURIEs.
Official geometry_relation values include within, equals, disjoint, intersects, touches, contains, covers, coveredby, overlaps and crosses.
period and date-year/month/day match parameters provide current/all and before/since/match temporal filtering semantics.
limit and offset are the documented pagination controls.
field and exclude_field control returned fields, with field taking precedence over exclude_field.
quality is an official entity-search filter.
Bulk dataset downloads are available as CSV, JSON and where applicable GeoJSON and Parquet.
Official guidance warns that absence of results does not prove absence of constraints because coverage varies by area.
The API is documented as beta and may change for production users.
